in_marathi.name: Avikrant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bravery beyond limits
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avikrant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avikrant refers to one who transcends all boundaries and limitations. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of several deities and heroes who defied the laws of nature and achieved great feats.

vedic_reference.note: Avikrant is a compound Sanskrit name composed of two roots - 'Avigat' (meaning 'not present') and 'Krant' (meaning 'change'). This name can be interpreted as one who brings change when he arrives or someone who is not present yet in a situation.
